object_classes.definition: A framework-internal artifact emitted by QICN-SYSTEM and not by itself admissible as external adjudication evidence.
A typed artifact family that may later be given to independent reviewers under explicit provenance and surface discipline.
A later evidence object satisfying provenance, independence, control, and statistical admissibility burdens.
A candidate evidence object that fails provenance, independence, control, or substitution constraints.
A future typed human-side artifact with legitimate collection lineage and channel attribution.
A later reviewer or adjudicator assessment produced under the external protocol.
A later typed decision object emitted only after admissible evidence has been evaluated.
A later package sufficient for independent rerun and methodological scrutiny.
A later preregistration object constraining protocol drift and threshold fishing.

forbidden_transitions.reason: Internal bridge support is not external validation.
Paper 9 does not substitute for external adjudication.
Opening readiness is not adjudication execution.
Scaffold existence is not result-bearing authorization.
Protocol definition does not imply human equivalence.

non_claims: No external adjudication verdict is emitted at Stage3-0.
No human comparator data is emitted at Stage3-0.
No public validation claim is emitted at Stage3-0.
No Paper 10 final authorization is emitted at Stage3-0.
interpretation_boundary: Stage3-0 defines the external adjudication architecture only. It does not execute adjudication and does not authorize external claims.
